description: This file contains test cases for verifying the behavior of PyTorch's JIT compiler, particularly focusing on enabling and disabling JIT compilation within tests. It defines test classes, context managers, and test methods that execute scripts with different JIT configurations to compare their behavior.

classes.name: TestJitDisabled
classes.description: A unittest TestCase class that tests JIT disabling and re-enabling behavior in scripts.

methods.name: _jit_disabled()
methods.description: A context manager that temporarily sets the environment variable 'PYTORCH_JIT' to '0', disabling JIT, and restores it afterward.

methods.name: compare_enabled_disabled(self, src)
methods.description: Runs a given Python source code string with JIT enabled and disabled, then compares their outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_attribute(self)
methods.description: A test method that checks the behavior of a ScriptModule with an attribute when JIT is disabled/enabled.

methods.name: test_script_module_construction(self)
methods.description: A test method that verifies that constructing a scripted module behaves correctly under JIT configuration.

methods.name: test_recursive_script(self)
methods.description: A test method that verifies scripting of a non-ScriptModule class with JIT enabled and disabled.
